title: Kiwi Grove | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to book this Gorgeous home: * Newly remodeled in February 2024!* Gulf Views from the Huge Balcony * Beach Access right across the street * Private fenced in Pool (Heated for $43/nt)* 6 Fun Pug Bikes Included!* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-mo
description_expanded: Top Reasons to book this Gorgeous home: * Newly remodeled in February 2024!* Gulf Views from the Huge Balcony * Beach Access right across the street * Private fenced in Pool (Heated for $43/nt)* 6 Fun Pug Bikes Included!* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* 5 Bedrooms and 2 Living Rooms * Large Gulf Facing Patio and Balcony * 1.2 miles to Seaside* Cafe 30A, Angelina's Italian and Dough Sea Dough Donuts nearby* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is not available to adults under age 25. No Exceptions.* At Kiwi Grove, you have found your new beach vacation home for years to come. This magnificent, 3440sqft beach house is directly on Hwy 30A in the heart of Seagrove Beach. Kiwi Grove features 5 bedrooms, 5 full baths, and sleeps up to 16 guests comfortably. There are 3 king beds, 2 queen beds, 2 sets of twin over queen bunks- most all bedrooms and BOTH living rooms have a Flat screen TV. This incredible home is wonderfully designed, from the large tiled floors to custom tiled bathrooms, natural granite in the kitchen and bathrooms, and masterfully crafted cabinetry. The large 2nd floor living/dining area boasts an expansive wood dining table seating 10, plus extra seating at the breakfast bar. As an added bonus to this home, the Santa Clara Beach Access is just steps away from the home, which offers clean restrooms and a lifeguard on duty. Relax beach side on the large balcony and porch spanning the width of the house, with views of the Gulf from the 2nd floor. Stroll down to the beach anytime you want, with access just steps away. If you get tired of the beach, take a dip in the private fenced in pool. The gated driveway has parking for 5 vehicles, so bring your friends. With Gulf Views from the 2nd floor balcony and your own private pool, this is the all-in-one vacation you have been looking for.The Bed Setup: 1st Floor: Master Bedroom: King Bed Guest Bedroom: King Bed Guest Bedroom: two sets of twin over queen bunks 2nd floor: Guest Room: King Bed Guest Room: 2 Queen Beds Area Attractions: Seaside is a fantastic destination, most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. Its incredible architecture has helped to make it famous but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous. There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17 mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
